newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Twelve feared dead in Vietnam after boat accident.
newsitem.headline: Twelve feared dead in Vietnam after boat accident.

text.p: Twelve people, mostly women and children, were feared dead after a passenger and cargo riverboat capsized in Vietnam's central province of Quang Nam Da Nang, the Lao Dong newspaper said on Saturday.
Provincial officials were not available to comment on the report, which said the accident occured on the Tranh River last Tuesday after the captain fell overboard with the vessel's rudder.
"The people in the boat were scared and made the boat turn upside down," Lao Dong said.
It said that of the 30 passengers on board, 12 were still missing, including a six-year-old child and a pregnant woman.
